name: US Treasury Bill Calculator
meta_title: Treasury Bill Calculator: T-Bill Price and Yield
meta_description: Find a T-bill price from its discount rate, or the discount rate from its price, plus the investment rate (bond-equivalent yield) and interest earned.
subtitle: Work out what a Treasury bill costs at a given discount rate, or the discount rate behind a price, along with the investment rate and the interest you earn at maturity.

card.fields_html:
Enter your Treasury bill

$

The amount paid back at maturity. Bills are sold in multiples of $100.

days

Useful for a bill bought on the secondary market or a cash management bill.

%

The rate quoted in auction results, based on face value and a 360-day year.

$

For example 98.0 means you pay $980 for a $1,000 bill.

More options

Used only for the investment rate, which counts the actual days in the year.
